discrepancies.issue: Pre-Rerank Hit@1 and Hit@3 Narrative Mismatch
discrepancies.root_cause: Typographical transcription error when synthesizing narrative ablation table from raw run.
Under-reported post-rerank rank-1 count by 1 sample in narrative report.

discrepancies.issue: Dense-Only Ablation Row Lacks Output Artifact
discrepancies.reported_in_doc: Dense Only: Hit@5=0.940, Recall@5=0.814, MRR@5=0.724, NDCG@5=0.710
discrepancies.root_cause: Standalone dense ablation lacks an underlying serialized execution artifact in evaluation/outputs/.

discrepancies.issue: Orphan Entity Rate Conflated with Dangling Edge Rate
discrepancies.actual_raw_value: Orphan Entity Rate: 58.9% (93/158 entities); Dangling Relation Rate: 0.0%
discrepancies.root_cause: Definition confusion: degree=0 orphan entities were mislabeled as dangling relation edges (relations referencing invalid node IDs).

discrepancies.reported_in_doc: Q17 described as the sole failure across all retrieval stages
discrepancies.actual_raw_value: Q17 is the sole failure in Pre-Rerank candidate retrieval (rank 7). In Post-Rerank, Q17 is promoted to Rank 1, but Q40 (Grading breakdown) is demoted from Rank 1 to Rank 6, causing Q40 to become the post-rerank Hit@5 miss and triggering LLM refusal.
discrepancies.root_cause: Failing to distinguish between pre-rerank candidate pool failures and post-rerank context window failures.

discrepancies.issue: Internal Keyword Recall Inconsistency in Error Analysis
discrepancies.reported_in_doc: Header states Mean Keyword Recall: 54.5%; Recommendation #1 states Keyword Recall: 82.4%
discrepancies.actual_raw_value: Mean Keyword Recall across 50 questions is exactly 54.53% (27.2667 / 50)
discrepancies.root_cause: Stale number (82.4%) left over from an earlier sub-group evaluation or draft.

discrepancies.issue: Dual MRR Presentation Without Contextual Labeling
discrepancies.reported_in_doc: MRR@5 reported as 0.785 in Section 2.4 / Section 3, but as 0.788 in Section 2.4 and Section 3 summary pitch
discrepancies.actual_raw_value: 0.7853 is strict capped MRR@5 (ranks > 5 score 0); 0.7882 is unbounded MRR including Q17 at rank 7 (1/7 = 0.1429)
discrepancies.root_cause: Interchanging strict MRR@5 and unbounded MRR without consistently qualifying the cutoff.

discrepancies.issue: Test Suite Pass Count Drift Across Documentation
discrepancies.reported_in_doc: 584 passed, 6 skipped (final_evaluation_report.md) vs 580 passed, 10 skipped (METRICS_MATRIX.md line 34) vs 594 passed, 6 skipped (current repo)
discrepancies.root_cause: Recent test additions (+10 tests: 2 answer error, 4 canonical relation, 2 graph rag, 2 routing) were not back-propagated to all documentation files.
